item.title: Stay Tuned
item.description:
First real write-up is coming soon — probably starting with a walkthrough of SecureBank, a small banking API I built to actually learn AppSec hands-on, including what happened when I deliberately reintroduced real vulnerabilities and tested whether my own CI security pipeline would catch them.

Until then — the code’s public if you want a preview.
